06 AI Render — Power Form Image

打浦桥街道 AI 渲染报告

同一固定机位下,把每种权力体制的体块(结构,实算)与AI 渲染(表面,论述)并排对照。 提示词显式拆成 [计算层](从 05 实算的栋数/高度/形态指纹)与 [论述层](config.yaml 里主张的外观)。

结构 = 诚实

体块由 pipeline 计算,footprint / 高度 / 天际线可追溯。参考图约束 AI 不许加减楼。

表面 = 论述

材质 / 氛围是 config.yaml 里写的主张,illustrative,非这座城真实的样子。

逐权力体制:结构、表面、提示词

现状

current

[计算层] 诚实,可追溯

approximately 1370 buildings, high-rises up to ~176 m, average height ~34 m

[论述层] illustrative,可改 config.yaml

the district as it currently stands, mixed building ages, heights and uses, realistic everyday materials

完整 prompt(发给模型)
aerial three-quarter view of an urban district, fixed camera of a Shanghai lilong and Tianzifang alley district around Dapuqiao. Structure (from the reference image): approximately 1370 buildings, high-rises up to ~176 m, average height ~34 m. Appearance: the district as it currently stands, mixed building ages, heights and uses, realistic everyday materials. photorealistic architectural visualization, soft daylight, gentle atmospheric haze. strictly preserve the exact massing, building footprints, heights and skyline of the reference image; do not invent, add, remove or move buildings. high detail, realistic materials, ambient occlusion, coherent lighting

过渡动画

互动画布(找角度,导出 ControlNet 条件图)

拖拽 orbit 找机位、切权力体制、导出 massing / depth / normal / seg / canny。自含单档,浏览器直接开。

开互动画布 canvas.html

诚实边界

  • 渲染图 illustrative:体块忠实(参考图约束 + negative 护栏),外观是 AI 按论述层想象。
  • 模型偶尔仍偷改天际线,出图肉眼核对体块有没有被篡改。
  • 动画:算子强度扫描最诚实(每帧真算子);crossfade 是观感润色,中间态混合/想象。
  • 固定机位贯穿:相机不动,画面里动的只有形态 = 纯权力信号。
